title: AISHELL-3 corpus index, speaker-disjoint split and 26-phoneme coverage
hypothesis: The published train/test split is utterance-level, not speaker-level (170 of 174 train speakers also appear under test/), so a speaker-disjoint 180/19/19 split is required before any speaker-independent claim; with the current 26-phoneme inventory fewer than half of the syllable tokens are renderable, and a small set of missing onsets (zh, ch, h, r) plus frequent finals accounts for most of the blocked mass.
